messages.subject: CPD: 'Disclosure under PD 57AD' lunchtime session - 21 Jan
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that the litigation group's CPD lunch on Practice Direction 57AD disclosure takes place on Tuesday 21 January at 12:30 in the 6th floor training room. Sandwiches provided. One CPD hour. Please reply to let me know if you'll attend so I can confirm catering numbers.

Thanks,
Donna
